_comment: Managed OMO settings merged by `setup.sh sync` into ~/.omo/agent/settings.json.
Only the keys listed here are merged; unrelated user keys are preserved.
UPDATED 2026-09-16 for omo 5.0.0-0.beta.65 (senpi 2026.9.16), source-verified:
beta.65 exposes more compaction knobs than beta.7 did. resolveCompactionSettings
accepts: model, keepRecentTokens, reserveTokens, speculativeEnabled,
speculativeFraction, summarizationMaxDurationMs, idleCompactionEnabled.
STILL MISSING: no threshold-ratio override. The trigger is contextWindow x a
window-derived ratio (policy.js baseThresholdRatioForWindow: 0.6/0.7/0.8,
clamp 0.4-0.85), so large windows fire late (1M window ~800K). No GJC-style
compaction.strategy=handoff or thresholdPercent equivalent exists.
ROOT CAUSE of commit failures (all-time compaction.log): speculative applied
4/51, plus blocking failures 'exceeded 120000ms budget' / 'Codex usage limit
reached' / 'did not apply'. These stem from summarization defaulting to the
heavy session model sharing its quota.
FIX: compaction.model pins summarization to a separate fast model so it commits
reliably and does not share the session model's rate limit (breaks the
usage-limit death spiral). Threshold-ratio lateness needs an upstream change.
BRICK INCIDENT 2026-09-17: omo self-edited ~/.omo/agent/settings.json and set
compaction.reserveTokens=850000. senpi policy.js resolveEffectiveReserveTokens
uses max(configured, min(0.04*window, 49152)), so a huge configured reserve is
forced verbatim. On claude-opus-4-8 (1M window) the start-time floor became
system 10197 + tools 10766 + output 128000 + reserve 850000 + speculation 32768
+ safety 16384 = 1048115 > 1000000, so assertModelUsable refused EVERY session
('context window is 48115 tokens short of the minimum'). omo bricked itself.
GUARD: reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens are now MANAGED here so `setup.sh sync`
overwrites any dangerous self-edit. 16384 is the upstream default; scaling lifts
it to 40000 on a 1M window, leaving the prompt budget usable. NEVER set
reserveTokens anywhere near the context window.
OAUTH-400 FINDING 2026-09-17 (herdr live, real ~/.omo/agent, source-verified):
compaction.model=anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 commits ONLY while anthropic OAuth
accounts are fresh. The summarization auth path (_getSummarizationRequestAuth
-> getAuth) does NOT rotate accounts the way the main request path does, so
when the selected account's token is expired it fails 'summarization
credentials unavailable' while the main model still works. Anthropic OAuth
refresh keeps returning HTTP 400 (44x/3d at platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token)
-> accounts periodically die -> compaction stops committing -> context balloons
to ~235K and is re-sent every turn = the abnormal token usage. Refresh 400
correlates with 3+ concurrent omo instances sharing one auth.json (single-use
refresh-token rotation race; login-2 stateVersion=168). The refresh code lives
in a vendored SDK, not patchable here.
DECISION 2026-09-18 (byun): keep compaction.model=anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 for
claude-quality summaries (NOT gemini). To stop the 400 recurrence from killing
compaction, keep anthropic access tokens fresh proactively. omo exposes
'omo auth print-bearer-token --provider anthropic --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
--min-expiry <dur>' which refreshes the shared token BEFORE it expires (verified
rc=0). A user crontab entry (marker OMO-ANTHROPIC-KEEPALIVE) runs it every 30 min
with --min-expiry 3h, so the shared auth.json token never drops below ~3h and the
non-rotating summarization path always finds a live account. Access tokens last
~8h. Cron needs explicit PATH (mise node + npm-global) since env is minimal.
Note: keep-alive reduces but cannot fully eliminate refresh races from 3+
concurrent omo instances; the only full elimination is fewer concurrent instances.
(gemini-2.5-flash is a verified fallback: api-key auth, immune to the 400, if the
keep-alive proves insufficient.)
